description: This file is a POSIX unistd.h header implementation for Zephyr OS, defining POSIX constants, macros, and function prototypes related to POSIX API support in Zephyr.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes a name from the filesystem.

methods.name: gethostname
methods.description: Gets the hostname of the current machine.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Suspends execution for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: usleep
methods.description: Suspends execution for a specified number of microseconds.
